data.name: Room Rules
data.detailed_description:
An atmospheric first-person research experience where you act as an Operator undergoing procedural trials within an unstable anomalous space known as the Room.

Each session is a controlled experiment.
Each action is part of a protocol.
Failure does not end the trial — it returns you to the beginning.

Core Gameplay Loop

You begin each session inside a research hub.

Here you:

  • review instructions on a tablet,

  • interact with control terminals,

  • monitor best completion times.

Once the procedure is activated, access to the object is granted.

The Trial

Upon entering the house, the timer starts.

Inside is the Room — the primary anomalous testing zone.

Screens display an object that must be located.

Your actions depend on the situation:

  • if the object is absent, you must exit the Room through the left door;

  • if the object is present, it must be correctly placed before exiting through the right door;

  • if time expires, side exits are blocked and only the central corridor remains accessible.

Rules and Consequences

  • A correct decision reduces the remaining level counter

  • An incorrect decision resets progress to the starting value

  • The objective is to complete all levels without violating the procedure

Once the counter reaches its final value, you may exit the house.
The timer stops.

Return and Analysis

After returning to the hub, you can:

  • review your final completion time,

  • compare it against previous attempts,

  • immediately restart the trial cycle.

The experience encourages repetition, optimization, and strict adherence to procedure.

Key Features

  • Procedural, rule-based gameplay

  • Observation and decision-focused challenges

  • Timer-based trials with best-time tracking

  • Minimalist laboratory-inspired visual style

  • Psychological tension without jumpscares

  • Short sessions designed for replayability

The Experience

This is not a traditional horror game or a classic puzzle experience.
It is a simulation of working with an object that cannot be fully understood.

You are not exploring the Room.
You are executing a procedure.

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION PROTOCOL RR–00

Document Status: Internal Use Only
Access Level: ███
Object: Interactive Research System Room Rules
Purpose: Operator training for interaction with anomalous spatial entities classified as “Room”.

1. General Information

1.1. Room Rules is a simulation environment designed to model procedures for controlling and studying unstable spatial anomalies.
1.2. The user receives the status of “Operator” and is granted access to Test Sessions.
1.3. The primary ANOMALOUS OBJECT CONTROL PROTOCOL: “ROOM” is currently active.
1.4. Information regarding additional objects is under review: ███████████████████.
1.5. Expansion of the Research Zone is planned after the completion of phase ██/██.

2. Purpose and Objectives

2.1. Preparation of Operators for work involving spatial anomalies of varying instability.
2.2. Analysis of Operator behavior under exposure to unpredictable environmental factors.
2.3. Evaluation of procedural accuracy and compliance with Protocol regulations.
2.4. Collection of data required for further Protocol revisions: ███████.

3. Procedural Section

[ACCESS RESTRICTED]

3.1. The full sequence of Operator actions has been redacted under directive from the Control Department.
3.2. Access to sections 3.3–3.7 is prohibited (status: CLASSIFIED).
3.3. ██████████████████████████████████████████████████
3.4. ███████ interaction ████████ transition point ███
3.5. In the event of deviations from procedure, Protocol ███–FAILSAFE will activate.
3.6. ██████████████████████████████ (removed).
3.7. The Operator must follow all current terminal instructions.

4. System Features

4.1. Interface presented in the form of protocols, reports, printed instructions, and technical documents.
4.2. The environment reflects a minimalist laboratory design fully aligned with active procedures.
4.3. Psychological tension is created through the uncertainty of the anomalous object and the requirement for strict rule adherence.
4.4. The system supports expansion. New “Room”–class objects will be integrated following classification: ██ class, ██ stability rating, access level █ or higher.

5. Current Development Status

5.1. The primary Protocol is fully operational.
5.2. Preliminary research on additional objects is ongoing.
5.3. Phases ██–██ completed. Phase ██ is currently undergoing internal testing.
5.4. Documentation on object “Room–██” is temporarily unavailable.

6. Control Department Notice

6.1. Non-compliance increases the probability of Error to ██%.
6.2. An Error will result in immediate Operator evacuation and full data reset.
6.3. Re-training is permitted and recommended.
6.4. Information regarding consequences of three or more consecutive Errors is classified: ████████████████.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10750H or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
